annotations.title: GitHub user repos: what an account has built

description: GitHub user or organization by login: its public repositories ranked by stars, each with description, stars, forks, language, topics, license and last push, plus the repository count, total stars, language mix and latest activity. Repository data only: no profile, e-mail, avatar or follower data. Use to see what a developer or company has built, vet a maintainer by their projects, or find an organization's main repositories. Example: user=vercel. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

count.description: Repositories to list, most starred first, 1-30 (default 10)

forks.description: true to include repositories forked from others (default false)

user.description: GitHub login of a user or organization, e.g. vercel, or its github.com link

name: github_user
